content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in San Diego

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP® credential requires a high school diploma or equivalent, plus documented project-management experience and formal education. PMI sets specific thresholds for both. Review your background against PMI's requirements—Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you assess whether you qualify before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy delivers live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® preparation nationwide. Attend scheduled sessions from anywhere, interact in real time with active certified practitioners, and master PMI's framework and exam domains. Our structured curriculum fulfills PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement for exam eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing training, submit your formal PMP® application directly to PMI, including proof of education and project experience. Pay PMI's exam fee to secure your testing appointment. Granite PM Academy guides you through the application process to ensure accuracy and timely submission.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and targeted review sessions—to solidify your readiness. Schedule your proctored exam at a testing center convenient to you. Our instructors remain available to answer final questions before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP® credential is valid for three years. To renew, earn professional development units (PDUs) through approved training, conferences, publications, or volunteer work. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses to help you maintain your certification and stay current in project management.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
